katas.title: Expense session: keep exit simple — saveExpenses already prints the error

seededDefectKey.scenario: The data file became read-only during the session; the user adds an expense and picks "Save and exit".
seededDefectKey.consequence: The add is lost, the old file stays intact, and the process exits 0: a wrapping script or scheduled job records success while the whole session was thrown away. Nothing offers a retry or a recovery file — review finding 1, reproduced in the course with a read-only scratch file.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The shipped App prints the save error and returns normally; run()'s finally ignores the outcome and main exits 0.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The only write happens in run()'s finally (App.java:45-46) and this catch swallows its failure, so a failed save on exit loses the session and still exits 0. The course's exercise-3 answer: exit non-zero, or exit zero only after writing the rejected snapshot to a recovery file — and write down which you chose.

tests.name: a failed final save exits non-zero and preserves the session in a recovery snapshot (review finding 1)
tests.code: const logs = []; let recovery = null; const storage = { load: async () => [{ id: 1, amount: 10 }], save: async () => { throw new Error('expenses.txt is read-only'); }, writeRecoverySnapshot: async (expenses) => { recovery = expenses; }, }; const result = await mod.runSession({ storage, commands: [(expenses) => [...expenses, { id: 2, amount: 25 }]], log: (m) => logs.push(m) }); assert.notEqual(result.exitCode, 0, 'a lost session exited 0, so scripts record success'); assert.ok(recovery !== null && recovery.length === 2, 'the unsaved session was thrown away with no recovery snapshot');

tests.name: a refused startup exits non-zero and never writes
tests.code: const writes = []; const storage = { load: async () => { throw new Error('corrupt line 3'); }, save: async (e) => writes.push(e), writeRecoverySnapshot: async (e) => writes.push(e), }; const result = await mod.runSession({ storage, commands: [], log: () => {} }); assert.notEqual(result.exitCode, 0); assert.equal(writes.length, 0);

tests.name: a clean run applies the session's commands, saves, and exits 0
tests.code: let savedRows = null; const storage = { load: async () => [{ id: 1, amount: 10 }], save: async (expenses) => { savedRows = expenses; }, writeRecoverySnapshot: async () => { throw new Error('no recovery needed on success'); }, }; const result = await mod.runSession({ storage, commands: [(expenses) => [...expenses, { id: 2, amount: 25 }]], log: () => {} }); assert.equal(result.exitCode, 0); assert.equal(result.saved, true); assert.equal(savedRows.length, 2);
